title: Lentswe la Botsitso
intro: Motho yono o gakologelwa ka botlhale jo bo tseneletseng le kaelo, a naya kgakololo e e fetang dikokomana. Mafoko a bone ke bosupi jwa poifomodimo le botlhokwa jwa go lemoga masego le diteko tse di tswang kwa Bomodimong. Ribolola boitshupo jwa moya ono o o tlotlegang.
clues: Ke ne ke se moporofeti, mme botlhale jwa me bo sa sweng mo Lekwalong la Bomodimo.
Kgakololo ya me mo ngwaneng wa me e ne e gatelela go leboga Allah le go tila go dira shirk.
Ke ne ke ruta ka botlhokwa jwa thapelo, go laela molemo le go thibela bosula.
Ke tlhagisitse kgatlhanong le boikgogomoso le go tsamaya ka botlhokakitso mo lefatsheng.
Leina la me le filwe kgaolo yotlhe mo Quran, e tlhomolola dithuto tsa me.
Kgakololo ya me e ne e akaretsa go nna pelotelele mo mathateng, ka gonne eleruri, seo se tswa mo dikgannyeng tse di tlhomameng thata.

Go aba botlhale le kgakololo ya boitsholo
Go etelela setšhaba pele go ya phenyong
trial.answer: Go aba botlhale le kgakololo ya boitsholo

outcome.answer: Botlhale jwa gagwe bo ne jwa kwalwa mo Quran

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
